newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Amsteel in theme park deal.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Amsteel in theme park deal.

text.p: Amsteel Corp Bhd said on Friday that a company in which it has a 70 percent stake is to take part in a joint venture proposal to develop and operate a theme park in central Melaka state.

The proposed Mahkota Seaworld Project will be on a four acre site with the first of two construction phases involving an aquarium to be completed by mid-1998 and a theme park to be finished by the end of 1999, the statement said.
In a statement, Amsteel said the venture is between its Ayer Keroh Resort Sdn Bhd unit and Underwater World International Pte Ltd of Singapore.
Underwater World is a 54.3 percent-owned unit of Haw Par Leisure International Ltd, which in turn is owned by Haw Par Brothers International Ltd.
The joint venture will be undertaken by a company known as Bayu Lautanjaya Sdn Bhd in which Ayer Keroh will own 40 percent and Underwater World the remaining 60 percent.
Ayer Keroh proposes to fund the equity in the joint venture company at a total of 2.7 million ringgit through internal funds.
